question: Which of the following is the SI unit of velocity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**m/s**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Velocity: The rate of change of displacement of a body is called the velocity of that body.

​Rightarrow Velocity=(Displacment (x))/(Time (t))

 
• Velocity is a vector quantity that has both magnitudes as well as direction.

EXPLANATION__:

 
• The unit of velocity is m/s and the dimension of velocity is [M0LT-1].
